text: We're expanding our partnership with @USGSA. Under a new OneGov agreement, we are bringing Claude to federal, state, local, tribal, and territorial governments at 40% off.
zh: Anthropic：与美国总务署扩大合作，按新 OneGov 协议，Claude 以四折优惠（减40%）提供给联邦、州及地方政府。

text: U.S. consumer confidence rises sharply in October.
zh: 白宫：美国10月消费者信心大幅回升。

text: Over the past few months, Anthropic scientists have engaged in deep research partnerships with six organizations developing new medicines. We've also begun drug discovery efforts of our own.
zh: Anthropic：过去几个月与六家新药研发机构深度合作，并已启动自己的药物发现项目。

text: The first shipment from the historic Venezuela oil deal arrives TODAY in Corpus Christi, Texas! ... this oil will belong to America and will be refined at home, increasing domestic supply and LOWERING PRICES at the pump.
zh: 白宫：委内瑞拉石油协议首批原油今天运抵得州科珀斯克里斯蒂，将在美国本土炼化，增加国内供应、压低油价。

text: NEW: The SEC's Division of Trading and Markets created an Innovation Exemption website with related FAQs, a list of persons that submitted TSV notices, and contact information.
zh: 美国证监会：交易与市场部上线「创新豁免」专题网站，含常见问答、已提交通知的机构名单及联系方式。

text: Tune in on Oct. 29 at 6:30am ET (1030 UTC) to watch two astronauts deploy a new solar array on the @Space_Station.
zh: NASA：两名宇航员将于美东时间10月29日6:30（北京时间18:30）出舱，为国际空间站安装新太阳能电池阵，届时直播。

text: Good — quoting: THE CEASEFIRE HAS COMMENCED. The ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia took effect at 4:00am Moscow time on October 27, 2026, two days ahead of schedule.
zh: 马斯克：「好」——转评消息：俄乌停火已于莫斯科时间10月27日凌晨4点生效，比原计划提前两天。

text: Excited to share Genie 4 today our most realistic and interactive world model: steer dynamic environments in real time... generate native audio matched to the world.
zh: 皮查伊：谷歌发布最逼真、交互性最强的世界模型 Genie 4，可实时操控动态环境，并生成匹配场景的原生音频。

text: Starlink Brasil — quoting @Starlink: Starlink Mobile is now live in Brazil with @vivobr! 50M customers can use apps and messaging in cellular dead zones — with 7M phones already connected.
zh: 马斯克：星链手机直连服务已在巴西与 Vivo 合作上线，5000万用户可在无信号区用应用和发消息，已有700万部手机接入。

text: Our Hera spacecraft can now see Didymos and Dimorphos as two separate asteroids! It will study the effects of NASA's 2022 DART impact and help advance asteroid deflection as a planetary defence technique.
zh: 欧空局：Hera 探测器已能分辨双小行星 Didymos 和 Dimorphos，将研究 NASA 2022 年 DART 撞击效果，推进小行星偏转防御技术。

text: Tomorrow at 2:30 p.m. ET: Chairman Warsh hosts live #FOMC press conference
zh: 美联储：主席沃什将于美东时间周三14:30（北京时间周四凌晨2:30）召开 FOMC 议息新闻发布会。

text: Falcon 9 launches 27 @Starlink satellites from California
zh: SpaceX：猎鹰9号从加州发射27颗星链卫星。

text: NVIDIA and @Meta will expand our partnership on @Muse models to improve inference and training performance. Together, we’re exploring NVIDIA OpenShell for safe AI agent deployment and NVIDIA Sentry for monitoring agent behavior. Meta plans broader deployments of NVIDIA Vera
zh: 英伟达：将与 Meta 扩大在 Muse 模型上的合作，提升推理和训练性能；双方正探索用 OpenShell 安全部署 AI 智能体、用 Sentry 监控智能体行为，Meta 还计划更大规模部署英伟达 Vera。

text: SimBioSys' FDA-cleared TumorSight Risk, powered by NVIDIA, analyzes an existing breast MRI alongside pathology to help assess breast cancer recurrence risk.
zh: 英伟达：SimBioSys 用英伟达技术的 TumorSight Risk 获 FDA 批准，结合乳腺 MRI 和病理评估乳腺癌复发风险。

text: GPT-6.1 Terra: delivering fast and capable computer use at a lower price.
zh: OpenAI：发布 GPT-6.1 Terra，主打更快、更便宜的电脑操作能力，能看懂屏幕并跨应用执行任务。

text: Supervised FSD approved in Latvia! — quoting @Tesla_Europe: Tesla FSD Supervised (Tesla Assisted Driving in Europe) approved in Latvia, the 10th European country.
zh: 马斯克：特斯拉监督版 FSD 获拉脱维亚批准，已是第 10 个放行的欧洲国家。

text: It means entire countries and cultures will go extinct forever — quoting: at 1.14 children per woman (Italy, Japan), each generation is roughly half the size of the one before.
zh: 马斯克：生育率 1.14（意大利、日本水平）意味着每代人口约减半，整个国家和文化会永久消失。

text: Be suspicious of unexpected emails claiming to be from the Federal Reserve. Scammers send fake fraud alerts and scare tactics to steal your financial information.
zh: 美联储：提醒警惕冒充美联储的邮件，骗子用假的欺诈警报吓人套取金融信息。

text: America's manufacturing sector has expanded for nine consecutive months, with 72,000 manufacturing jobs added in 2026 through September.
zh: 美国财政部：美国制造业已连续 9 个月扩张，2026 年前 9 个月新增 7.2 万个制造业岗位。

text: Audi is investing a historic $4 billion to build its FIRST-EVER production facility in the United States.
zh: 白宫：奥迪将投资 40 亿美元建其首座美国工厂，称是关税和制造业回流政策的成果。

text: Starlink coming to EasyJet — quoting: easyJet will install Starlink across its A320/A320neo/A321neo fleet from H1 2027, complete by early 2028.
zh: 马斯克：易捷航空将装星链，2027 上半年开始在 A320 系列机队安装，2028 年初完成。

text: Anthropic has filed an S-1 registration statement with the SEC related to its proposed IPO.
zh: Anthropic：已向美国证监会递交 S-1 招股文件，拟进行 IPO。

text: Starship Flight 15 static fire — quoting @SpaceX: Full duration 33-engine static fire for the Super Heavy booster preparing for Flight 15
zh: 马斯克：星舰第15次试飞的超重型助推器完成33台发动机全时长静态点火测试。
